# `scport`

Generate single-cell portrait outputs via external scPortrait converter

- Wrapper: [`job_scport.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_scport.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-scportrait`

## Inputs

- general.denoised_images_folder and general.masks_folder

## Outputs

- scportrait.projects_root (default scPortrait/) project outputs
- outputs/<execution_id>_scPortrait_Export/ stage report under sbt

## Configuration

- general, scportrait

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl scport
```
